name: Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice
description:
A `BluetoothDevice` object lets you create a connection with the remote device or query information 
about it, such as the name, address, UUID and type.

properties.name: address
properties.summary: Address of the remote Bluetooth device.
properties.description: This property returns the Bluetooth hardware address as string. For example, "00:11:22:AA:BB:CC".

properties.name: name
properties.summary: Name of the remote Bluetooth device.
properties.description: This property returns the Bluetooth name or null if there was a problem.

properties.name: type
properties.summary: Type of the remote Bluetooth device.
properties.description:
Possible values are DEVICE_TYPE_UNKNOWN, DEVICE_TYPE_CLASSIC, DEVICE_TYPE_DUAL and 
DEVICE_TYPE_LE.

properties.name: uUIDs
properties.summary: The supported UUIDs of the remote device.
properties.description:
This property does not start a service discovery procedure to retrieve the UUIDs from the 
remote device. Rather, the local cached copy of the service UUIDs are returned. Can be null
on error.

methods.name: createSocket
methods.description:
This method, when called, creates an RFCOMM Bluetooth socket ready to start an outgoing 
connection to the remote device using SDP lookup of UUID.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.summary: UUID of the service this socket will connect to.

parameters.name: secure
parameters.summary: Determines whether the connection will be secure or insecure.

methods.name: fetchUUIDs
methods.summary: Perform a service discovery on the remote device to get the UUIDs supported.
methods.description: The outcome of the discovery is reported via the [fetchedUUIDs](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice#fetchedUUIDs) event.

returns.summary: Returns true if service discovery started successfully.

events.name: fetchedUUIDs
events.summary: Fired when the UUIDs of the remote device are received using SDP.

properties.name: UUIDs
properties.summary: The service UUIDs of the device.
